info.title: opencligen
info.summary: Validate OpenCLI descriptions and generate code and docs from them
info.description:
opencligen validates OpenCLI descriptions (https://opencli.org/) against the OpenCLI schema and its own rules, and generates a urfave/cli v3 command tree in Go, a Markdown reference or a man page from them.

The x- metadata it understands is described in docs/extensions.md.

options.name: --lenient
options.description: Report problems that can be worked around as warnings instead of errors: x- metadata that cannot be typed, and features the output cannot express.

options.name: --allow-c-limits
options.description: Accept C limit constants such as INT_MAX, -FLT_MAX or I64_MIN in x-range and x-default.

exitCodes.description: The description has errors, or the output cannot be generated

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check a description against the OpenCLI schema and opencligen's rules

arguments.name: spec
arguments.description: The OpenCLI description, a JSON file

commands.name: urfave
commands.description:
Generate a github.com/urfave/cli/v3 command tree in Go

The generated file declares a Handlers interface with one method per runnable command and a New function that builds the command tree wired to it.
